request: Build Frontier Lab mode into HivemindOS Zero Human Companies with company-scoped intelligence budgets, budget-aware capacity scheduling, elastic workers, tiered model routing, cockpit metrics, staged scale gates, and end-to-end tests

entries.note: Adapted the existing cross-process lock, corrupt-ledger fail-closed, idempotent reservation, and bounded durable-write patterns for company-scoped model tokens.
Extended the native apex-goal to Queen Bee to Work Board call chain with capacity calculation and tier tags instead of building a parallel scheduler.
Extended the established claim, machine-slot, worker chat, independent judge, and terminal settlement path with OAuth policy and token accounting.
Reused the Cockpit panel, loading, metric, guardrail, error, and responsive interaction conventions for Frontier Lab.
Adapted the isolated-ledger and deterministic-clock coverage pattern for reservation, settlement, release, and budget exhaustion.
